principle: Extend existing OIS registries/contracts; do not create parallel registries or replace the kernel.

registry_mapping.memory: OIS execution context / memory subsystem boundary

contract_strategy.capability: Reuse CapabilityContract; encode domain-specific schema references, provenance, metrics and validation profile in metadata until a verified kernel extension is justified.
contract_strategy.agent: Reuse AgentContract; declare required_tools, model_requirements and max_iterations.
contract_strategy.tool: Reuse ToolContract; declare network policy, secrets, approval, side effects and idempotency.
contract_strategy.workflow: Register versioned workflow definitions through existing WorkflowRegistry; workflow nodes reference capability/agent/tool IDs.
contract_strategy.model: Reuse ModelRegistry; provider/model routing is a model concern, not a social-domain registry.
contract_strategy.policy: Use PolicyEngine for authorization, publishing, tool use, platform restrictions and approval gates.
contract_strategy.memory: Persist versioned evidence/artifacts/patterns through the existing memory boundary; do not create a social-only memory store.
contract_strategy.measurement: Emit domain metrics tied to execution_id, workflow_id, capability_id, agent_id, tool_id and artifact IDs.
contract_strategy.learning: Learning creates candidates/evidence; Controlled Evolution governs promotion. No autonomous mutation from a social metric alone.
contract_strategy.observability: Use existing telemetry/audit boundaries; every social action must be reconstructable from execution identity.
